messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU queue growth detected in us-west1-primary. Autoscaler failing to add capacity; attempted spillover to eu-west1 returning 503s. P95 latency > 1.2s, queue depth rising. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/queues/us-west1

maria: paging SRE oncall. @ajay can you take?

ajay: oncall here, looking. pulling queue metrics...

ajay: dashboard shows queue depth jump 27k -> 118k over 6m, token generation rate flat. autoscaler log shows repeated errors: 
```
2026-03-15T18:04:12Z ERROR autoscaler: failed to request additional gpus: QuotaExceeded: request for 150 GPUs denied (project quota 100)
```

lia: eng-runtime oncall. we also have a restart of autoscaler-agent at 18:03 with OOM during reconciler loop. dumping agent logs now.

keegan: routing note: spillover started but many requests returned 503 from eu-west1 because model variant mismatch against pinned versions. fallback policy attempted to requeue to primary which made queue worse.

ajay: confirming 503 cascade: logs show 502/503 spike on cross-region proxy during initial spillover window.

maria: severity decision? customer impact visible? @jordan from CS?

jordan: CS here — some customers experiencing degraded generation (timeouts/retries). I have an open ticket for two enterprise customers, both reporting higher latencies and failed requests. ETA from ops?

ajay: setting sev=2 for now. prioritizing mitigation to restore throughput.

alex: eng-runtime chiming in. autoscaler process repeatedly hit quota errors and then OOM on reconcile; looks like two separate failures stacked. I'm going to manually provision capacity and force routing changes.

alex: running manual scale command (internal):
```
$ rwi pool scale --region us-west1 --pool gpu-primary --add 120 --reason "incident 3361237890 - manual top-up"
Started scaling job job-4829. Estimated provision time ~ 7m.
```

lia: I'm pushing a temporary relax of our model-variant pinning for routing so eu-west1 will accept requests for compatible variants (risk: slightly different fp/quantization, but prevents 503s). doing change now.

keegan: noted. that will at least stop the requeue->spike loop. accept risk for customer impact reduction.

ajay: also bumping per-route concurrency throttle to reduce burst pressure while nodes come up:
```
> /ops throttle set --route generation --concurrency 40
```

maria: please keep updates in thread. I'm logging actions for post-incident review. :memo:

alex: scale job completed, nodes appear in pool. kube nodes ready. provisioning nftools shows GPUs allocated. queue drain starting.

ajay: queue depth now 118k -> 45k and dropping. tail latency back to ~600ms. still some 503s observed but much reduced.

jordan: notifying impacted customers with ETA ~60m for full recovery; will update with timeline.

lia: note for postmortem: root cause appears to be a combination of cloud GPU quota enforcement (we hit a hard limit) + an autoscaler memory leak causing restart at peak. when autoscaler restarted it didn't surface quota errors into runbook alerts so nobody manually topped capacity quickly.

keegan: routing config hole: fallback policy requeues by default; when primary is saturated that requeue loop amplifies queue. need to change to immediate cross-region spillover with backpressure instead. raising a follow-up RFC.

maria: handing off to next oncall in 30m — @ajay please make sure runbook ticket + pager escalation docs are updated.

ajay: acknowledged. I'm creating ticket and assigning to eng-runtime for fix and to infra for quota lift: INC-3361237890-ticket link: https://tickets.internal/INC-3361237890

alex: I pushed a short-term autoscaler fix to prevent OOM on reconcile and added explicit quota check that surfaces a clearer alert. will follow up with PR for permanent fix.

maria: status check 20m later?

ajay: queue stable at 12k, P95 ~ 480ms, error rate normalizing.

jordan: CS updated customers, no major data loss, mostly transient failed requests. they asked for postmortem and timeline.

lia: next steps: 1) quota increase request to cloud provider (in progress), 2) autoscaler memory leak postmortem + patch, 3) routing policy change to avoid requeue amplification, 4) add explicit synthetic alert when cross-region 503 rate crosses threshold. assigning owners in ticket.

maria: closing incident channel after handoff. thanks all. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident 3361237890 marked RESOLVED by maria at 2026-03-15T19:12:58Z. Summary: manual scale + routing relax recovered throughput; follow-ups created: INC-3361237890, RFC-3362001 (routing), PR-7462 (autoscaler fix).
